article.title: Dialpad與Ada宣布合併，擬串連通訊、客戶情報與AI代理
article.title_en: Dialpad and Ada announce combination to connect communications, customer intelligence and AI
article.summary: 11月4日公告稱交易尚待完成，現有客戶的合約、價格及支援安排繼續。
article.summary_en: The November 4 announcement describes a pending transaction, with existing contracts, pricing and support continuing.
highlights: 結合方向是通訊、客戶資料理解及代理執行，產品路線仍會補充。
公司稱現有整合維持原設定，客戶毋須因公告立即更改。
highlights_en: The planned platform combines communications, customer intelligence and AI execution.
Existing integrations continue as configured; customers need no immediate change because of the announcement.
article.why: 使用客服或客戶溝通工具的團隊，可提早詢問產品整合與資料責任，安排續約評估。
article.why_en: Customer-communication teams can ask about integration roadmaps and data responsibilities before renewal.
article.next_step: 保存現行服務及權限清單，向客戶團隊確認後續路線與合約影響。
article.next_step_en: Document existing services and permissions, then ask account teams about roadmap and contract effects.
article.detail: 兩家公司希望把通話與客戶情報接到能完成工作的AI代理，先由客服場景開始，日後再擴展其他客戶關係流程。這是已宣布的結合計劃，並非交易已完成或所有功能已整合。原聲明說現有價格、客戶團隊及支援繼續，更多路線將稍後公布。本報未引用交易估值、營收或部署量，也未把公司對未來服務體驗的願景寫成已量度的結果。
article.detail_en: The companies aim to connect communications with agents that complete customer work, starting with service. The announcement is not a completed transaction or full product integration. Current pricing and support continue, with more roadmap details to follow. No financial or performance projections are used.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
